name: CheckCommitments
description: Sets the outcome of payment commitments (CustomerNotes noteType התחייבות לתשלום) — plan 04.11 part A, stage 2. Run by RunDaySchedule in the bank-check phase (09:00 / 10:00) only after the bank statement was found in Priority, the receipts run and the second PullOpenMovements. Checks every active commitment whose check day has come: check day = actionDate + noteTask.promise.offsetDays (AgentSettings, default 1) ≤ asOfDate, and outcome פתוחה, קוימה חלקית or לא קוימה (קוימה is final). A commitment whose check day passed on a day the bank never loaded is simply checked on the next run — nothing is lost. Promised = amount, else balanceAtNote. Received = every receipt of the customer since noteCreatedAt (date ≥ the note's day): Priority receipts (Payments mirror) plus, until the Priority API exists, our receipts approved here (Receipts receiptStatus אושרה – לא נשלחה or later) — a receipt present in both is counted once; credit notes never count. Outcome: the month's open balance (OpenMovements) is 0 or less, or received ≥ promised → קוימה; 0 < received < promised → קוימה חלקית; nothing received → לא קוימה. Writes outcome, amountReceived, amountRemaining (max(promised − received, 0)) and checkedAt. The note stays active until its month reaches 0 (CloseSettledNotes). Then the grouped task התחייבויות שלא קוימו – ליצור קשר (key notes:promise:<date>:<bookkeeper>) is synced. Optional customerCode / noteIds limit the run. dryRun (default true) only reports. Never writes to Priority or contacts anyone.

asOfDate.description: Testing: the day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today, Asia/Jerusalem)

commitments.description: {noteId, customerCode, dueMonth, promised, received, remaining, monthBalance, outcome, previousOutcome, receipts}
